name: Tafamidis

similar.name: Benoxaprofen
problems: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1982 — for kidney harm, stomach and gut problems and blood problems

examples.title: A Study to Compare the Amount of Two Forms of Tafamidis in the Blood of Healthy Adults Under Fed Conditions
examples.why: The study was terminated for business reasons; there were no safety concerns.

summary: According to a small computer model rather than human tests, Tafamidis received a high score of 83 for liver concerns and a low score of 15 for heart concerns [M]. The drug shares a 42 percent similarity with Benoxaprofen, which was removed from the worldwide market starting in 1982 due to kidney damage, stomach and bowel harm, and blood-related issues [3]. Two specific clinical trials for Tafamidis were stopped or changed, with one ended early for business reasons without safety problems and another moved into a different study [6][7].
